item: a wiki dump, OSM download or OSM resume whose worker thread cannot start answers 409 with a named detail, not a 500
summary: The managers raise RuntimeError when the worker thread cannot start (R393/R398); the three routes mapped only ValueError, so the caller got an unhandled 500. Each now maps RuntimeError to 409 through http_detail. Three tests with a refusing manager fail (500) without the change.
